messages:
olga: heads-up, bringing up fenrir-7b (Gemma fork) via qwen loader + int4. seeing hallucinations on short summaries.
raj: can you repro? which quant args?
olga: repro on devbox + CI. example prompt: "Summarize refund policy for orders placed before midnight." model invents a clause like "30-day full refund if order id ends with 7".
luis: pattern: failures spike on inputs with zero-width joiner / combining diacritics. tokenization differs -> kv-cache offset -> rotary misalignment.
amanda: quick mitigation: normalize and strip ZWJ in loader, and keep rotary sin/cos tensors in fp16 during quant.
ci-bot: CI job 8123: quant-smoke failed; bench job queued.
olga: agreed. filing issue to preserve rotary metadata in converter and add special-char CI eval.
